|x13 = -101.5 |y13 = 79.12 |z13 = -175.5 }} '''Elle''' is an [[NPC]] on the {{zone|Crimson Isle}}. She acts as a guide, and helps explain the new systems, factions and mobs there. == Quests == '''Elle''' is one of the main [[NPCs]] for the [[Crimson Isle Main Questline]] for both [[Factions]]. She first appears in the {{Zone|Stronghold}} trying to fight three {{MobSprite|Blaze (Elle's Quest);Blazes}}, after which she tasks the player with bringing her {{Item|Magma Chunk|amount=4}}, {{Item|Blaze Ashes|amount=3}} and {{Item|Spectre Dust|amount=2}}. After the player does this, '''Elle''' will start leaving the Stronghold. She will be in front of the {{Zone|Chief's Hut}} within {{Zone|Dragontail}}, and outside the {{Zone|Community Center (Scarleton)}} within {{Zone|Scarleton}}. She will then task the player with speaking to four [[NPCs]] from each [[Faction]], so that they can make their mind up about which one they want to join. The quest then splits depending on which faction was chosen. '''Elle''' is also required to access the Basic Tier of the [[Kuudra]] fight. {{Dialogue|
&e[NPC] &cElle&f: Captain Ahone, Ugo, this is a misunderstanding!
&e[NPC] &cElle&f: I saw what happened! I saw everything!
&e[NPC] &cElle&f: A monstruous<sup>[sic]<\/sup> creature was carrying the Sulphur, mountains of Sulphur!
&e[NPC] &cElle&f: The monster had giant tentacles, I have never seen anything like it before in my life!

&e[NPC] &5Captain Ahone&f: Elle of the Nether, do not attempt to trick us.
&e[NPC] &5Captain Ahone&f: Your motives are noble, but time for diplomacy is over.
&e[NPC] &5Captain Ahone&f: Barbarians, return our Sulphur at once, or face the consequences of your actions.

&e[NPC] Ugo&f: WE stole YOUR Sulphur?! You wizards have some nerves!
&e[NPC] Ugo&f: We came here following the trails of the Sulphur that YOU robbed!

&e[NPC] &cElle&f: ENOUGH!
&e[NPC] &cElle&f: You were BOTH robbed, isn't it obvious?!
&e[NPC] &cElle&f: The culprit is inside, and it is not Human nor Piglin.
&e[NPC] &cElle&f: I have no idea what it is, but I have to warn you, that fiend is immensely powerful.
&e[NPC] &cElle&f: Now if you wish to retrieve your Sulphur, follow me inside.

&e[NPC] &5Captain Ahone&f: This giant tentacle monster story is real?
&e[NPC] &5Captain Ahone&f: I have trouble believing it, but in any case we have to get to the bottom of this.

&e[NPC] Ugo&f: I agree, let's get inside.

&e[NPC] &cElle&f: Hum, so you chose the &cMage Faction&f then.

&e[NPC] &cElle&f: In which case, you must have met &cMaddox&f?
&e[NPC] &cElle&f: Both &cMaddox &fand his brother are in fact from &5Scarleton&f, but contrary to the other inhabitants, the 2 brothers were born without any magical aptitudes.

&e[NPC] &cElle&f: They got banned from the &7Academy &fduring their first year, and even got exiled from the island after a terrible incident.

&e[NPC] &cElle&f: In fact I have one myself. Here take it, I'll just request another one from &cMaddox&f. I keep losing them.
}}

&e[NPC] &cElle&f: Captain Ahone, Ugo, this is a misunderstanding!
&e[NPC] &cElle&f: I saw what happened! I saw everything!
&e[NPC] &cElle&f: A monstruous<sup>[sic]<\/sup> creature was carrying the Sulphur, mountains of Sulphur!
&e[NPC] &cElle&f: The monster had giant tentacles, I have never seen anything like it before in my life!

&e[NPC] &5Captain Ahone&f: Your motives are noble, but time for diplomacy is over.
&e[NPC] &5Captain Ahone&f: Barbarians, return our Sulphur at once, or face the consequences of your actions.

&e[NPC] Ugo&f: We came here following the trails of the Sulphur that YOU robbed!

&e[NPC] &cElle&f: The culprit is inside, and it is not Human nor Piglin.
&e[NPC] &cElle&f: I have no idea what it is, but I have to warn you, that fiend is immensely powerful.

&e[NPC] &5Captain Ahone&f: This giant tentacle monster story is real?
&e[NPC] &5Captain Ahone&f: I have trouble believing it, but in any case we have to get to the bottom of this.

&e[NPC] Ugo&f: I agree, let's get inside.
}}
